current.name: The Binding Patch
current.notes:
🔧 *LUMORA 1.2.6 — THE BINDING PATCH*

A maintenance pass. Nothing flashy — just the things that were quietly broken, fixed, and the things that were ugly, made clean.

🏆 *The leaderboard works again.* `.lb` had been throwing on every single call — the global board now renders rank, name, faction, DΞP, Lucons and Vault, with a shard tally per hunter.

⛓️ *The Abyssal Chain of Binding* is now a *permanent* market relic. Rift Seekers no longer have to pray `.bind` lands — the chain takes it from a coin flip to near-certainty.

🎨 *Combat card retouch.* The hunting move list was rewritten into a proper HUD: styles, merged Mora moves and basics grouped, power bars, accuracy, riders and affordability — no more squinting at a flat wall of text.
stages: 🏆 *Leaderboard repaired* — `.lb` no longer crashes. Global board shows rank / faction / DΞP / Lucons / Vault, with shard counts appended to every hunter.
💠 *Vault weighting* — leaderboard score now counts total shards + 2× distinct species, so the new shard economy actually scores.
🧬 *Factionless fix* — players with no faction now read *Unaligned* instead of a blank line.
⛓️ *Abyssal Chain of Binding (REL_004)* — new Mythic relic. Bonded Rift Bind success 30% → 98%. Now a *permanent* listing in the market, plus a Rift-member discount in the faction market.
🎨 *Hunting combat HUD* — move list rebuilt: grouped by style / merge / basic, power bars, accuracy, energy cost, riders (heal, brace, never-miss, counter), and a live energy footer.
🥋 *Style buffs surfaced* — move cards now show the active fighting-style rarity buff instead of hiding it.
⚰️ *Dead code removed* — the orphaned leaderboard menu helper and the unused top-players block are gone.

pending.name: The Sunday Gift
pending.notes:
📜 *LUMORA 1.3.0 — THE SUNDAY GIFT*

Every Sunday, from 00:00 CAT, a new trial of the scriptures opens for 24 hours. Answer scripture, receive blessing.

🧠 *Fresh questions every week.* The bot writes a brand-new set of Bible-knowledge questions each Sunday — mountains, prophets, verses, journeys — so no one can memorise the answers.
stages: 📖 *The Sunday Gift* — opens Sunday 00:00 CAT, closes Monday 00:00 CAT. 24 hours only.
🧠 *AI-written questions* — a fresh pool of scripture questions generated every week; a curated fallback bank keeps the event alive if the AI is offline.
🎚️ *You choose the trial* — pick anywhere from *4 to 10* questions. Longer runs pay more.
⛔ *Six strikes* — fail six questions and the Gift closes its doors on you for the week.
💰 *Guaranteed Lucons* — Lucons scale with how many you answered correctly (roughly 3k for a clean run).
🐉 *A random Epic Mora* — every rewarded run crystallises an Epic shard into your vault.
✨ *Blessings* — a perfect run earns a *Blessing*, which will later power reduced energy drain and other boons.
🎁 *Rotating bonus rewards* — extra Lucons, bonus shards, Aura or relics change weekly, so the Gift never pays the same twice.

history.name: The Scroll Trials
history.notes:
🌟 *LUMORA 1.2.5 — THE SCROLL TRIALS*

📜 *Quest rework is LIVE.* No more dead ends. Fighting styles are now earned through real quest lines:

🕯️ *Secret codes* — every registered player holds personal, one-time codes for every scroll-gainable style. Get a style scroll, open it in your DM, and it reveals your code. Speak the code in any group chat to begin the trial.
stages: 📜 *Scroll Trials (all 15 styles)* — receive the scroll → open it in DM → speak your secret code → you're teleported to a foreign land with PROCEED / RETREAT choices → story beats with CONTINUE → a named NPC challenger who uses that style → beat them to reach the teacher.
🎖️ *Level barriers* — rare styles gate at level 8–10, epic at 15, legendary at 25. The teacher refuses anyone too green — the trial stays open, no dead ends.

💰 *The teacher's price* — each style demands real materials (dropped non-certainly while hunting, with hints where to find them) plus a Lucon fee scaled to the style's power. Retreat anytime; speak your code again to resume exactly where you stood.
🕳️ *Discoveries* — while hunting you may stumble on a mysterious cave, humming grotto, or lightless burrow. ENTER for materials, Lucons, or a guardian battle — or LEAVE freely.
🎁 *Loyalty gift reworked* — .claim-gift now unlocks Wind Step directly and thanks you for staying for V2, with constant updates and live events promised.
🎓 *Guided tutorial* — join a faction, pick Begin or Skip, get the world links for Hunting Grounds 1 & 2, Battleground, and Market Place, and take your first hunt with a Start Tutorial button.
👑 *Admin Tokens Council* — Prime or the Right-Hand posts tasks (*.admin <task>*), sudos take them up, verified work is cleared and tokens are granted. The lowest earner is demoted each cycle.
🏆 *Leaderboard overhaul* — faction stats aligned: Purity = Resonance · Rift = Bounty · Harmony = Honour.
🌐 *Wiki updated* — every fighting style, its gate, teacher, materials, and fee documented at *.wiki-url*.
🎭 *Gender flow fixed* — real buttons, 'Rather not say', and you can change your answer anytime.
